name: Minami Hasuno
source:
[Spoiler]The actress who plays [url=/c93368]Suzuki Moe[/url] in the art house film named 'Dasoku'. 

She left her home to become a famous actress and is very unhappy with her role. 

Perished during the 'incident'.[/spoiler]
